latestVersion.changelog:
Video Best 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly enhance and export videos with automatic AI-driven color correction and noise reduction—no manual editing needed.
- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and receive optimized 1080p MP4 files.
- Streamlined setup with quick authentication and seamless backend connection.
- Supports fast, credit-based cloud GPU rendering for content creators; shorter clips process faster and use fewer credits.
- Simple chat commands for uploading, enhancing, status checks, and exports; works with multiple video, audio, and image file types.
- Error handling, session management, and translation of backend GUI responses into clear, actionable feedback.
